entries.name: Akashic search source code
entries.notes: The repository license covers Akashic-authored code; external resource names and trademarks remain with their owners.

entries.name: Akashic natural-language search evaluation v1
entries.notes: The fixture contains Akashic-authored judgments and links; it does not redistribute or relicense content from the linked sites.

entries.name: Akashic natural-language search evaluation v2
entries.notes: The v2 fixture extends v1 without copying it, records Akashic-authored query-relative judgments and links, and does not redistribute or relicense destination content.

entries.name: Akashic deterministic search result checkpoints
entries.notes: The reports are deterministic Akashic artifacts and do not contain model weights, tokenizers, or mirrored third-party documents.

entries.name: Transformers.js
blockers: Select and pin an immutable runtime release or commit.
Generate a complete transitive dependency and notice inventory.
Measure the dependency and transfer cost against a direct ONNX Runtime Web integration.
entries.notes: The runtime license does not license any separately downloaded model, tokenizer, or converted weight artifact.

entries.name: ONNX Runtime Web
blockers: Select and pin an immutable runtime release or commit.
Inventory the exact WebAssembly, WebGPU, and auxiliary files that would be published.
Measure browser support and fallback behavior before adoption.
entries.notes: The runtime is independently licensed from every ONNX model and tokenizer it executes.

entries.name: sqlite-vec
blockers: Select one offered license and pin an immutable release or commit.
Inventory the SQLite and WebAssembly build inputs separately.
Demonstrate a measured need beyond exhaustive typed-array search.
entries.notes: This is a future comparison only; the architecture currently prefers a flat index. The repository also publishes LICENSE-APACHE.

entries.name: WebLLM
blockers: Keep local generation outside the semantic-retrieval experiment.
Select and pin an immutable runtime revision only if the optional Navigator reaches evaluation.
Review every separately distributed model and compiled artifact.
entries.notes: A permissive runtime license does not approve any model offered through a runtime registry.

entries.name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
blockers: Pin one immutable model revision and an exact file manifest.
Review the disclosed multi-dataset training provenance and limitations independently from the repository-level model license.
Verify conversion provenance, numerical equivalence, tokenizer behavior, and browser transfer size.
Use it only as a full-dimension baseline because the model card does not claim Matryoshka-trained prefixes.
entries.notes: The model card declares Apache-2.0 and 384-dimensional embeddings, but its disclosed training mixture contains many separately governed datasets.

entries.name: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5
blockers: Pin one immutable model revision and an exact file manifest.
Audit or eliminate remote custom code before executing the model in a build.
Review the model data card and training-data provenance separately from the model repository license.
Verify task prefixes, Matryoshka truncation, conversion provenance, numerical equivalence, and browser transfer size.
entries.notes: The model card declares Apache-2.0, Transformers.js usage, and Matryoshka truncation; those facts make it a candidate, not an approved dependency.

entries.name: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5
blockers: Pin one immutable model revision and an exact file manifest.
Review training-data provenance and documented limitations separately from the released-model license.
Verify the repository-provided ONNX artifact, tokenizer behavior, numerical equivalence, and browser transfer size.
Treat it as a compact full-dimension baseline unless prefix truncation is supported by primary model documentation.
entries.notes: The model card declares the released model under MIT and includes ONNX files, but no artifact is approved for Akashic yet.
